data.name: Sunset Sail
data.headline: Relaxing sunset cruise through calm intracoastal waterways with dolphin-spotting opportunities.
data.description: Enjoy a peaceful cruise through the bay at SkyBeach Resort Marina as the sun dips below the horizon. Glide along calm intracoastal waterways that set the scene for unforgettable colors on the water while guides point out playful wild dolphins. This relaxed outing is perfect for guests who want to unwind, watch wildlife, and capture sunset views from the water.
data.highlights:
* Scenic sunset views over the bay
* Opportunities to see wild dolphins in their natural habitat
* Calm intracoastal waterways ideal for a relaxing cruise

meeting_point.address: 6800 Sunshine Drive South St. Petersburg, FL US 33705

data.cancellation_notes:
Customer Cancellation: Cancellations must be requested via call or email no less than 10 days before trip departure for a full refund. No shows will be charged full price. 

Weather Cancellations: If your trip's departure may be impacted by weather, our captains will reach out via text or email no less than 2hrs before departure with a weather update. Should the trip be canceled, guests are entitled to a full refund.
